1.w: A song of ascents. I look up toward the hills. From where does my help come?

2.w: My help comes from the Lord , the Creator of heaven and earth.

3.w: May he not allow your foot to slip. May your Protector not sleep.

4.w: Look! Israel’s Protector does not sleep or slumber.

5.w: The Lord is your protector; the Lord is the shade at your right hand.

6.w: The sun will not harm you by day, or the moon by night.

7.w: The Lord will protect you from all harm; he will protect your life.

8.w: The Lord will protect you in all you do, now and forevermore.
